description:
Cast Worldwalker Helm by paying {2}{U}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Worldwalker Helm spell.
Resolve both Worldwalker Helm spells.
Activate Urza by tapping a Worldwalker Helm, adding {U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus an additional Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza twice by tapping two Map tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 5.
